title: Yateem hai Sakina hai
body:
Haye...
riwayat mein ye hai jab bhi qafla daudaya jaata tha
sar e shabbir naize se (sadaa ye deta jaata tha)..(2)
sambhalo tum ise zainab
abhi bazaar jaana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Laee'n isko darate hai
kabhi durre lagate hai
sitamgar tez naaqo se
ise neeche girate hai
<<DIVIDER>>
sakina jab bhi roti hai
tamache bhi lagate hai
meri bachhhi ko aye zainab
laeeno se bachana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaha'n ye phool si bacchi
kaha'n seh roz ke faaqe
abhi dekhe hai khud isne
chacha aur bhai ke laashe
<<DIVIDER>>
bade sadme uthaye hai
kaee raato ki jaagi hai
hamare baad seene par
tumhe isko sulana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kaleja thaam lo zainab
ye manzar khoo'n rulata hai
mera sajjad ghairat se
nigaaho ko jhukata hai ke zalim ab sakina ko
<<DIVIDER>>
kanizi mein bulata hai
behen na paak nazro se
sakina ko chupana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Yazeed e nehes kehta hai
meri baali sakina se
agar hai pyaar baba ko to kehdo sar se khud aaye
hai waqt e imteha'n zainab
<<DIVIDER>>
meri bachhi na mar jaye
hamare sar ko khud uthkar
ab uske paas jaana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Gaye qabr e sakina par
juhi farhan aur mazhar
bohot roye kiya matam
jo dekha shaam ka manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
unhi logo ke narghe mein
ghiri hai aaj bhi muztar
wo hi tanhaiya'n bhi hai
andhera qaid khana hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
yateemi hai sakina hai, bada zalim zamana hai..(2)
